relevanceGrades.definition: Direct evidence sufficient for the requiredFact.
Useful context that is insufficient on its own.

ineligibleReturnDisposition: leakage and hard failure independent of relevance grade
positiveEvidenceAssociationRules: Create one PositiveEvidenceAssociation for every supported requiredFact.
A grade-2 association also requires relevantLocationGroupId.
locationGroupingRule: Equivalent or overlapping locations share a relevantLocationGroupId; independent locations do not.
semanticGroupingRule: semanticCaseGroupId is diagnostic and never replaces the canonical per-case macro.
reviewPolicy: two independent reviewers blinded to rank; both decisions and immutable adjudication retained
campaignBlockingRule: any unjudged item in final top five blocks the campaign
authoringPolicy: source-first authoring and unscored pooling before RB-2
